scope: Read-only feasibility and native-coordinate analysis. Sole authorized new file is this report. No imagegen, raster mutation, selection change or formal approval.
coordinateConvention: All coordinates are 0-based. Boxes are [left,top,right,bottom), half-open. Pixel contours are approximate anti-aliased boundaries.
findings: joint2_v03 repairs the internal beam discontinuity at tile y2048 but copies the wider upper column profile downward, moving the visible column discontinuity to the hard-insert bottom at tile y2560.

At native y700 through y1200, the generated column right contour is near x926 and target lower contour near x890, approximately 36 pixels apart. The bright-face threshold is near x770 versus x762, approximately 8 pixels apart. Outer-contour evidence is visual; color threshold alone can include neighboring warm foliage.

No valid horizontal cut in the current v03 native lower region resolves the column width mismatch. For a 1024-high crop contained in this 1254 image, its bottom lies at native y1024 through y1254, where the mismatch remains.
Changing a source crop must preserve world-coordinate mapping. Translating native artwork to conceal an edge offset is not a true-overlap cut and would shift scene geometry.
Both original overlap strips retain a column geometry mismatch. A lower MAE cut is not sufficient for structural approval.
The shortest proposed reconstruction is two adjacent 1024 cores, lower first and upper second. This is a feasibility recommendation, not a guarantee of a successful imagegen result.
